#   point of P_w in its interior.  |P_w| = 19,13,13,11,6 -- all < 23.

#   interior-disjointness graph computed exactly (19,13,13,11,6), matching |P_w| in all
#   five words, so each certificate is TIGHT; omega=19 for aabbcca independently reproduces
#   the known best partial Z1 (19 of 23).
